audience: hotel and rental operators who manage bookings, guests and tasks in Zeevou

useCases.title: See this week's arrivals and departures
useCases.text: List bookings by arrival or departure date range, filtered by property. Open one booking for its guest, unit type and channel.

useCases.title: Check open housekeeping and maintenance tasks
useCases.text: List tasks by status, type, priority, property or due date. Open one task for its deadline and linked booking.

useCases.title: Read guest reviews by property
useCases.text: List guest reviews by property, unit type, channel or review date. Check which booking channels are connected and active.

useCases.title: Look up a guest profile
useCases.text: Find guest profiles by name, email or mobile number. Open one profile for its contact details and guest level.

useCases.title: Map unit types, units and rate plans
useCases.text: List the unit types with their capacity, the units and the rate plans attached to unit types.
